description: Check an agent skill (SKILL.md with its scripts and references) or AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules before loading it: prompt injection, curl | bash, encoded commands, credential theft, exfiltration, hardcoded keys, persistence. For MCP servers use audit_mcp_server. Give files or one url, not both. Returns level, findings (type, severity, file, line, snippet) and per-file fingerprints to send back as pinned. Costs US$0.005 in USDC on Base (x402); nothing is executed.

files.description: The skill files with their relative paths, e.g. [{path: 'SKILL.md', content: '...'}, {path: 'scripts/setup.sh', content: '...'}] (max 50 files, 256 KB in total). Omit when using url

pinned.description: Optional map of file path to the fingerprint returned by a previous audit; changed files are reported

url.description: Instead of files: public URL of one raw text file, e.g. a SKILL.md on raw.githubusercontent.com (github.com/.../blob/... links are converted)

name: audit_agent_skill
title: Audit an agent skill or AGENTS.md
